stories.title: Wild’s Hughes, Kaprizov chasing history in win
stories.summary: Kirill Kaprizov and Quinn Hughes accomplished a feat that's only been done once in the last 33 years.

stories.title: Kaprizov, Hughes lead Wild past Flames 4-1
stories.summary: Kirill Kaprizov and Quinn Hughes extended their point streaks to 13 games on Thursday to lead the Minnesota Wild to a 4-1 victory over the Calgary Flames.

stories.title: Police pursuit of stolen loader up QEII into Airdrie ends with attempted murder charges
stories.summary: Two Mounties and a suspect were injured during a slow-going police pursuit of a construction vehicle stolen from Calgary, which ended when it got stuck in a slough near Airdrie.

stories.title: Man from India accused of kidnapping, sexual assault of woman held hostage in Airdrie
stories.summary: A man from India, in Canada on a visitor visa, has been charged with sexual assault, kidnapping and more after being arrested during a hostage standoff north of Calgary.

stories.title: Alouettes place eight players on All-CFL team
stories.summary: Montreal Alouettes quarterback Davis Alexander and receivers Tyson Philpot and Tyler Snead earned All-CFL all-star honours Thursday.

stories.title: Alberta tables law giving itself power to remove municipal bike lanes
stories.summary: Alberta's transportation minister is proposing legislation that, if passed, would prohibit any new bicycle lanes from taking away road space from vehicles — unless he approves it.

stories.title: More choice or anti-intellectual? Albertans mixed on new high school grad requirements
stories.summary: Albertans are still wrapping their heads around the incoming requirements to graduate high school that include more gym class and fewer core academic courses taken to the 30-level.

stories.title: Calgary is proposing big spending to improve road quality but some councillors say it’s not enough
stories.summary: Ward 10 Coun. Andre Chabot told Global News he is looking at clawing back Calgary Transit's funding request to help find more money to improve city roads during budget talks.

stories.title: Alberta proposes data centre buffer zone near homes, some farms and irrigated land
stories.summary: The Alberta bill setting new rules around major data centres and where they can be built comes at a time when 70 proposals are being considered for development in the province.

stories.title: Wide receiver Hollins retires from CFL
stories.summary: Wide receiver Alexander Hollins announced his retirement from the CFL on Wednesday, ending a five-year career that included a CFL West all-star nomination in 2023.
